backdrop.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: opaque side-scrolling driving-game panorama. Input 1 is the SEASONAL EDIT TARGET: preserve its biome, seasonal identity, broad tree placement and very wide composition. Input 2 is the APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its bold chunky tree shapes, rich saturated natural colours, confident visible brush strokes, readable silhouettes and crafted detailed storybook game illustration finish. Hand-painted, slightly stylised, soft diffuse light from ABOVE, no strong diagonal sunbeams. Layered forest depth with softly simplified distant trees and a blue sky with chalky-white painted clouds. Trees frame the sides and leave an open central view across the marsh. Keep the lower third a calm uninterrupted single-colour band for the game road; place all scenery above 66.5 percent image height. No foreground road, people, vehicles, structures, UI, text, logos, watermark or border. Full-bleed opaque landscape. Output EXACTLY 2172 x 724 pixels, 3:1 panorama; do not crop or zoom. Autumn: dense golden ochre, copper and rust-orange canopies with burgundy accents, warm bark and chalky-white hanging moss, small areas of deep green foliage and reeds. Still marsh water and leaf litter. Preserve autumn, not a summer recolour. The lower calm band is subdued olive-sage matching the target. Bold shapes and selective bark detail, similar visual complexity to style reference; avoid excessive tiny foliage and photographic texture.
